proof_summary:
A terminating Sears/Pfaff–Saalschütz hypergeometric transformation rewrites the sum as
\((3n+1)a(n)=(n+1)\sum_{2j\le n+1}\binom{3n+1}{n+1-2j}\binom{n+j}{j}\binom{2n-j}{n}^{2}.\)
For each summand, carry criteria for binomial coefficients give \(p\mid\binom{2n-j}{n}\) and an additional factor of \(p\) from one of \(n+1,\binom{n+j}{j},\binom{3n+1}{n+1-2j}\); hence the right side is divisible by \(p^3\), and since \(2p<3n+1<3p\), the factor \(3n+1\) is coprime to \(p\) and can be cancelled.
